## 5.1 Getting Started

Installing and loading the R Packages

```{r}
pacman::p_load(sf, sfdep, tmap, tidyverse,plotly,Kendall)
```

## 5.2 **Import csv file into r environment**

```{r}
hunan <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", 
                 layer = "Hunan") %>% 
  st_transform(crs = 32650)
```

```{r}
hunan2012 <- read_csv("data/aspatial/Hunan_2012.csv")
```

```{r}
GDPPC <- read.csv("data/aspatial/Hunan_GDPPC.csv")
```

### 5.2.1 Combining both data frame by using left join

```{r}
hunan <- left_join(hunan,hunan2012) %>%
  select(1:4, 7, 15)
```

## 

Creating a Time Series Cube

```{r}
GDPPC_st <- spacetime(GDPPC,hunan,.loc_col = "Country",.time_col = "Year")
```

```{r}
is_spacetime_cube(GDPPC_st)
```
